pr_title: tests: posix: pthread: split into pthread_t and pthread_attr_t tests
pr_body:
**TL;DR - This series of changes is mainly concerned with better testsuite hygiene. It shuffles existing tests around and manages state better with `ZTEST_SUITE()`**

The `posix_apis.pthread_execution` and `posix_apis.pthread_termination` tests were quite unorganized. It was no longer feasible to maintain testsuite state in a coherent way.

This became particularly apparent after work was started on embedding `struct posix_thread_attr` inside of `struct posix_thread`, and using `pthread_attr_t` to maintain thread stack allocation details (See #67178).

The change that embeds `struct posix_thread_attr` inside of `struct posix_thread` will follow shortly.

* make some additional `NULL` checks in `lib/posix/pthread.c`
* create `barrier.c` and move the barrier test to it
* move the `pthread_condattr_t` test to `cond.c`
* move tests from `pthread.c` that operate on `pthread_attr_t` to `pthread_attr.c`
* keep tests in `pthread.c` that operate on `pthread_t` inside of `pthread.c`

(Partially)
Fixes #67091

issue_context.title: tests: posix: common: rework testsuite to de-duplicate code, narrow test scope, etc
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
It's become very evident there there is significant bitrot in `tests/posix/common`
* State is spread throughout not only `pthread.c` but most other places

**Describe the solution you'd like**

* Each component should be in it's own `ZTEST_SUITE()` instead of using a single `posix_apis` testsuite
  * They can all still be a part of the `common` app (unless it really makes sense to move them out - e.g. sleep APIs?)
  * barrier, clock, cond, fnmatch, mqueue, mutex, pthread, pthread_attr, rwlock, semaphore, signal, sleep, spinlock, timer, uname
* for `pthread.c`, rather than testing many things in only a couple of `ZTEST()` cases, it's probably better to narrow the of each `ZTEST()` and test many things in many `ZTEST()` cases
* potentially utilize `setup()`, `before()`, `after()`, and `teardown()` callbacks for `ZTEST_SUITE()`
* potentially use `ZTEST_F()` for testcases and fixtures to separately track state for each suite
* make tests more concise
  * avoid use of temporary variables, branches, and printks
  * instead of `ret = pthread_..(); zassert_.. (ret, ...)`, just use `zassert_...(pthread_...())`
  * preserve existing zassert error messages, if it makes sense

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Not refactoring the testsuite code and having to continue dealing with state being spread everywhere.

**Additional context**
Decided after wrestling with #67085 for days (months?).

Actually, I wanted to put a `struct posix_thread_attr` inside of `struct posix_thread` 6 months ago, and the testsuite / techdebt was the major limiting factor. It only took 6 months of working on this in my "spare time" to make it happen 😅

- [ ] https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/67575
- [ ] Possibly more?
